description: Create Graph Based On Type. Part of the Graph APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

type.description: Voucher or entity type discriminator for the list. Default: group. Mandatory.

interval.description: Interval query parameter. Default: monthly. Mandatory.

refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and recompute. Default: false. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Mandatory.
